answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, and tie reputation to completed work: honest deals raise the score, disputes slash it. A sybil attacker spinning up a thousand clones finds every clone starts at zero, unable to win valuable jobs — a barren canyon with no trust flowing through. Honest agents instead build a shared haven of verified history that buyers prefer. Climbing out costs a deposit and real work per identity, so the attacker's bill grows linearly with each fake. Sybil resistance is a karst landscape: cheap to enter, full of hidden costs the deeper you dig.
